record.body:
The failed implementation was not a faithful reference port: after the reference entry it ran a separate per-frame coordinate/velocity/heading/rotation/floor controller. That competing transform owner was capable of producing the rapid backwards slide and pose corruption.

Installed build `E00D8E5C5FE1FF92158203B75E440E2EBFA446F6C6AF634796DA2923EC454ADE` removes that controller. Entry now performs the reference crouch + `mech_crawl@base/idle2stealth` calls back-to-back, waits 900 ms, then uses the reference mover flags for `walk`, `walk_turn_l4`, `walk_turn_r4`, and `onfront_bwd`; input release selects the reference idle flags. No ordinary prone frame writes coordinates, velocity, heading, rotation, or floor height. Release-visible logs now record entry, handoff, selected clip, stop, and measured motion.

Please test standing and crouched entry, brief W then release, A/D/S, and exit. This is installed for testing, not claimed accepted.
